query:
WITH inserted AS (
            INSERT INTO prompts (
                slug,
                title,
                description,
                tags,
                category,
                type_id
            ) VALUES (
                $1,
                $2,
                $3,
                $4,
                $5,
                $6
            )
            RETURNING
                id,
                slug,
                title,
                description,
                tags,
                category,
                type_id,
                created_at,
                updated_at
         )
         SELECT
            i.id,
            i.slug AS "slug!",
            i.title AS "title!",
            i.description,
            i.tags AS "tags!",
            i.category,
            i.type_id,
            pt.name AS "type_name!",
            i.created_at AS "created_at!",
            i.updated_at AS "updated_at!",
            NULL::integer AS "production_version?",
            NULL::timestamptz AS "production_version_created_at?"
         FROM inserted i
         INNER JOIN prompt_types pt ON pt.id = i.type_id
